name: Round 10 v4 closeout pre-registration
status: amended 2026-10-12 by owner request after v3 S1 started and was stopped; frozen before v4 production launch; preserve v3 unchanged
scope: four user items (validity 1a-1e; start-up bump G7 merged with encoder ladder; physics reference C11-C13 and Yimin ratio C10; encoder shrink) plus substrate (drop 7, T_avg mask, vs3 split, batch 0/1) plus additions of 2026-10-11 (NO_TIME, E3/G11, re-fit column, linear sysID baseline, F1 LOTO direct); v4: full fixed 20-seed comparison, unconditional G7c/d, strict ten-family direct/frozen-candidate evaluation and complete convection handoff

data.drop_reasons: Case 8 corrupted T_avg (val file, swapped for Case 10/Case 1); new 1/2/3 thermal diffusivity about 2x; Discharge 13 byte-identical to Discharge 11; new 19 is a copy of new 7's temperatures; new 20 shares new 18's inlet exactly and has no provenance (user decision 2026-10-11: keep new 18, drop new 20)
data.tavg_mask_rule: T_avg of inner-weighted (117) and borderline (1) files excluded from the loss and from every T_avg statistic (validation scalar, ratio mu/sigma, residual z-score, early-step weights); walls unchanged
data.test_set: Test_70_cases, untouched, read only at B6 and F11 through paper_report.py with an access log

hashes.digest: sha256 hex; list digests = sha256 of the SORTED keys joined by newline (tes_gru.utils.sha256_lines), so tavg_mask_train/val_sha256 equal run_config.json tavg_mask_train/val_sha256 under TAVG_MASK=split

seeds.pairing: by seed label; dp0.2/dp0.3 twins are identical models at 1 layer and are never both launched

statistics.unit: per-channel MAE in degC over the validation files (T_inner, T_outer on 20; T_avg on 17), full rollout, teacher forcing 0
statistics.paired_test: seed-paired mean difference; 95% CI from 10,000 bootstrap resamples; sign-flip exact enumeration for n<=16 and 50,000 fixed-RNG Monte Carlo flips for n>16 (unchanged analyze_round9.paired implementation)
statistics.primary_comparisons: one per batch; the rest descriptive or Holm within the named family
statistics.three_channel_mean: never the deciding statistic (T_inner barely moves and dilutes T_avg)
statistics.implementation: paper_stats.py (A5): paired_stats = analyze_round9.paired draw for draw; compare / compare_family apply the bands, vetoes, Holm and verdict classes of this file

bands.source: outputs/round10_plan/band_calibration_2026-10-11/band_recommendation.md (Round 9 per-case per-seed test csvs, resampled n=20)
bands.per_comparison_rule: band_c(P) = max(fixed band_c, sqrt((1.96*sd_case/sqrt(n))^2 + seed_bootstrap_halfwidth^2)) computed from that comparison's per-file paired differences; stated in the result table
bands.validation_set_not_enlarged: 30 files would move the T_avg case term from 0.058 to about 0.047 only; seed term unchanged; combined about 0.07; costs 10 training files

vetoes_validation_side.V1_blowup: any seed with mean of the three validation channel MAEs > 1.5 degC
vetoes_validation_side.V2_jumps: paired JumpSteps (thresholds 2 degC and 1 degC, T_outer+T_avg only, step t0->t1 included) increase across seeds with sign-flip p < 0.05
vetoes_validation_side.computed_by: eval_checkpoint --set val under SEAL_TEST=1; the FLAGGED/SWITCHED test-id sets are never applied to validation files

verdict_classes.BETTER: CI of (T_outer+T_avg)/2 entirely < 0 AND T_avg CI upper <= 0 AND T_outer CI upper <= +band_T_outer AND T_inner CI upper <= +band_T_inner AND no veto
verdict_classes.NO_WORSE: every channel's CI upper <= +band_c and no veto

recipe_change_rule: a challenger replaces direct only if BETTER vs C1 at h128x1, BETTER vs B1-mask at h160x1 (C17, 20 seeds) and the top-2 order holds on the F4 draws (2 of 3 required because band_T_avg > 0.05); the candidate is fixed before F4; the final recipe is frozen after F4 and before F1/F9; F1 never changes it; no selection after F9 launches

physics_reference_row_E1.parameters: r_o = 0.127 m, diffusivity scale s = 1.0 (training-file grid optimum; identical to nominal; grid in physics_cache_vs3/E1_training_grid.csv)

P0.content: hooks A0+H9, H1, H2, H3, H4, A4, A5, A6; 1b calibration (done); A8 cache and E1 row (done); A7 bridge on validation files; G1 port; A9 tables
P0.gate_to_P1: prereg committed with the bands above; smoke runs pass; sidecar round-trips to 1e-6 scaled on the 20 val files; all-ones mask reproduces current loss to 1e-7; runner forces SEAL_TEST=1

arms.B1: direct h160x1, mask vs orig, S20 (40)
arms.retrain: champion h160x1 abs 1-6-3 vs2 291 files orig labels S10 (10)
arms.B2: direct h128x1 mask / orig / relabel / drop-Case9, S20 (80)
arms.B7: random mask of the same number of training files, orig labels, h128x1 S20 (20); validation mask = same 3 masked val files
arms.B8: orig training labels, only masked val files masked in validation scalar, h128x1 S20 (20)

P1.primary: mask minus orig NO_WORSE on T_outer and on T_avg separately AND hot-discharge side score (Case 9 New 1, New 4: model T_avg vs s-inverse line average, seed-paired, n=2 files, no case-level claim) lower under mask with CI excluding 0
P1.controls: B7 must not lower the side score; if B8 explains more than half of (mask minus orig) on the side score, K04 is written 'label content plus stopping rule'
P1.descriptive: relabel, drop-Case9; retrain vs Round 9 server meta.json per channel with CI (K17 becomes a cross-machine mean difference)
P1.then: B6 test read #1; G1 probe on B1/B2/B7/B8 checkpoints

P2.arms: ANCHOR_SCALE x INPUT_LOOKAHEAD cells (6,0) (12,0) (1,1) (6,1) (12,1) (100); LOSS_W0_MODE=inv_kc share arm (20); C14 anchor off (20); C15 ANCHOR_LEAD=0 (20); direct h128x1 mask S20
P2.rule: two families registered separately; a cell adopted only if overall and T_inner CIs entirely < 0 AND T_outer/T_avg uppers <= +band; share arm same rule in its own family; C14 'anchor unnecessary' only if overall and T_inner CIs inside +/-band; C15 exploratory
P2.readouts: per channel; first-20-step T_inner on validation ramp files; T_inner on validation step files; spill-over; realised w0

P3.serves: item 3 ratio (Yimin), C16 points, Arnold's direct/subtractive/ratio table
P3.arms: C10 R3 all three ratios (primary, replaces the anchor); R1 T_outer only; R2 T_outer+T_avg; R2C Celsius floored at 20 degC (numerical control); C3 anchor_input on T_outer; C2 initial-value additive; each 20 seeds, h128x1 mask
P3.definition: Ref(t) = Input_T(t+1) + 273.15 K; ratio on raw degC; mu/sigma on training files only, T_avg from unmasked files; loss on reconstructed temperature; rollout and evaluate mirrored; identity gate 1e-4 degC on 5 files
P3.rule: R3 vs C1 by the verdict classes with T_inner included; BETTER -> C17; EQUIVALENT keeps direct; WORSE = second multiplicative counter-example on C16
P3.re_fit_column: anchor: mu/sigma; EMA: tau; ratio: mu/sigma; physics residual: k, rho, cp or one diffusivity; direct: none

P4.arms: G7(a) EARLY_STEP_WEIGHT steps 1-10; G7(b) window encoder; ENC linear 4->H; ENC 4-16-16-H; H0_MODE tanh with 256-256; H0_MODE zero; NO_TIME (feat_cols = [Input_T]); each 20 seeds h128x1 mask; G7(c) burn-in and G7(d) synthetic rest files also always run with 20 seeds; adoption remains conditional on the registered criteria
P4.encoder_rule: smallest encoder by parameter count with per-channel CI upper <= +band_c vs C1 on all three channels AND first-5-step spike share (max |err| > 1 degC on T_outer+T_avg per seed x val file) not worse than C1 becomes the reported encoder and parameter count
P4.G7_rule: treatment adopted only if the T0 sweep (constant inlet 50:600:10, 60 steps) stays within 0.5 degC on every channel AND first-5-step max error halves vs C1 with CI < 0 AND whole-run per-channel uppers <= +band_c; preference to an encoder change over step weighting
P4.NO_TIME_rule: adopted for deployability if every channel inside +/-band_c vs C1 (then confirmed at h160x1); otherwise reported as 'the model is a function of the step index' and the time column stays

P5.arms: C11 residual on physics for T_outer and T_avg; C12 C11 + physics series as input; C13 physics series as input only; each 20 seeds h128x1 mask; scored on masked labels only
P5.prereq: epoch-0 identity: zeroed residual rows give validation MAE equal to the E1 row (T_outer 0.543, T_avg 0.409) to 1e-3 degC
P5.rule: C11 vs C1 BETTER AND C11 beats the E1 validation row on T_avg (17) and T_outer (20) with CI < 0 -> C17; tie with C1 and both lose to E1 on T_avg -> written per decision tree 2b; C12 over C11 only if C12 minus C11 CI entirely < 0 on (T_outer+T_avg)/2; C13 exploratory; C11 never reported on the hot-discharge side score
P5.after: E3 and G11 inference-only on 1-D-generated property-shifted truth (k x 0.8 / 1.2): direct GRU zero-shot, C11 with the base shifted, pure 1-D nominal; G11 re-fits one diffusivity from the first N minutes (10/30/60); descriptive; C16 curves computed after P5

linear_sysID.serves: G11' rows and C16 points; the 'why ML' sentence
linear_sysID.method: least squares on the 284 training files: T_outer and T_avg_line as fixed-weight sums over 8-16 log-spaced exponential kernels of the inlet history (tau 10-3000 steps), Tikhonov; T_inner = Input_T(t+1) + FIR of inlet differences; global and per-100-degC-start-bin variants; order and regularisation chosen on the 20 validation files; test row at F11 only
linear_sysID.rule: descriptive; if the binned linear model lands within 0.5 degC of the GRU on T_outer, the paper's ML-value sentence is rewritten

P6.arms: one 20-seed h160x1 arm per adopted family from P2/P3/P5 (0-3), plus up to three adopted P4 encoder/startup/NO_TIME arms; capacity confirmation uses S20, not fresh seeds
P6.rule: winner minus B1-mask BETTER at h160x1 else direct stays; encoder/treatment per the P4 rules vs B1-mask

P7.arms: F4: splits seed43/44 x {direct, confirmed challenger}, h128x1 S10 (20..40); then freeze final recipe. F1: all ten inlet-family holdouts x {direct, frozen recipe if different}, h128x1 S10 (100..200), inner validation from non-heldout families; all fitted constants use fold training only; heldout-family labels excluded from fold fitting, early stopping and checkpoint selection; F1 results cannot alter the previously selected recipe; near-duplicate groups stay together
P7.rule_F4: top-2 order unchanged across vs3/43/44; a flip larger than the band on any draw -> three-draw mean decides
P7.readout_F1: per-family error as a multiple of the in-distribution error; '8 of 10 families within 2x' as the envelope statement (K15); envelope figure
P7.f1_interpretation: Report per-model per-family errors and candidate-direct paired differences; each model uses its own S42 in-distribution reference on S10. Ten repetitions are final, not screening.
P7.f4_pairing: Split42 reuses the complete main S20 panel; new splits43/44 use S10 each. Both arms have identical seeds within each split. Each split is judged separately; no across-split seed pooling.
P7.f1_selection_scope: Post-selection family-holdout evaluation of the fixed recipe. Main validation/F4 before F1 include examples from the inlet families; this is not nested family-unseen selection of the entire research pipeline.
P7.f1_physics_scope: C11/C12 use fixed FE-report nominal r_o=0.127 m, diffusivity scale s=1.0 driven only by inlet history. Material/geometry are not recalibrated within F1; residual mu/sigma/z0 are fit per fold train. Historical full284 E1 grid search selected the same nominal values and remains disclosed; globally calibrated reference branch is not used.

P8.arms: F9 frozen recipe h160x1 on the 20 fresh prime seeds; F10 direct h160x1 on the same seeds only if the recipe is not direct

P9.content: paper_report.py once: F9 (+F10); B1 pair with Round 9 h160x1 twins and the 4090 retrain (chain table); E1 physics test row; linear sysID test row; C16 test-side points for confirmed arms; 1d error budget on B1-mask and F9 with test floors (67-file 1-D yardstick, 21-case bracket-clip oracle, per-file residual upper bound); ensembles fresh20 and S20+fresh20 (40); historical machine bridge remains original S10

test_reads.B6: after P1: B1 mask vs orig h160x1 pairs on cases 70/42/66/67 only; values and paired-difference CIs; thresholds case 70 <= 1.5, 42 <= 2.0, 66/67 <= 1.0 degC; the other 66 cases summarised only as the paired-difference CI upper <= +0.03 without printing any arm's level; logged before the call; no decision changes
test_reads.nothing_else: SEAL_TEST=1 on every run; resume asserts sealed; probes on synthetic inlets or validation files only

deviations_and_disclosures: B6 is a pre-registered single look at four test cases after P1
1b (band calibration) used Round 9 per-case per-seed TEST csvs that had already been read in Round 9; no Round 10 model touched the test set

the origin/yash (PINN) branch evaluated on the 70-case set about 20 times between 2026-08 and 2026-09, and Round 9's main.py wrote Test_MAE on every run; the seal statement reads 'sealed from Round 10 onward, read at B6 and F11'
the T_inner anchor last-step off-by-one is fixed in Round 10; Round 9 T_inner numbers are not quoted next to Round 10 ones without this note
E1 parameter re-selection on training files only returned the nominal parameters (r_o 0.127 m, s 1.0); the earlier selection that touched test files is therefore immaterial but is disclosed
case 70 is an extrapolation after masking (only 4 Case 8 files with scored T_avg start at or above 500 degC in pure discharge)

v4 amendment made after owner stopped v3 S1; original registration preserved. Scientific thresholds, losses, epoch limits and datasets unchanged; more seeds do not establish novelty. F1 replaces full-train constants and heldout-family early stopping with strict inner validation and separate heldout scoring.
hygiene: no arm runs that is not in this file
smoke directories deleted before real runs
each arm has a unique run-name tag
champion retrain uses vs2/291/orig exactly as Round 9
TF32 flags pinned and recorded in run_config and sidecar
No 10-seed screening; all base scientific arms run20, including G7c/d, regardless of outcomes
Negative and undecided results are delivered, never used to request result-dependent extra seeds
Old v3 outputs are preserved in their original namespace and excluded from v4 inference

amendment.reason: One complete run, no 10-seed screening or later seed top-ups; hand off completed Round10 before convection
amendment.known_prior_execution: User reported v3 S0 passed, S1 B1_mask seed3 and seed1 completed, then stopped; complete process/run inventory not remotely verified. No B6/F11 access reported. restart-v4 audits server state and refuses prior test windows.
amendment.reuse_policy: New r10v4 run namespace. Preserve all v3 runs/state; do not reuse v3 checkpoints or inspect their validation scores for selection.
amendment.f1_change: Strict train/inner-validation/family-holdout separation. All fitted preprocessing from fold train; heldout family never used for checkpoint selection.
amendment.budget: 34 base arms x20 plus RETRAIN x10; F4/F1 x10; C17 x20; F9/F10 x20 fresh. 830..1090 training runs.

seed_policy.pairing: Every named comparison uses identical registered seeds; no silent intersection or optional topping up.
